_comment: VENDORED from Fashion Cabinet — do not hand-edit. A commit-pinned copy of madfam-org/fashion-cabinet:docs/interfaces/yantra4d-consumers.json (contract yantra4d_consumers_v1), the back-edge of the hardware bridge: which Fashion Cabinet garments consume which Yantra4D cartridge, and the parameter ids of ours they drive. document._comment: GENERATED by Fashion Cabinet (scripts/qa/generate_bridge_index.py) — the back-edge of the hardware bridge, published for Yantra4D to vendor and pin, exactly as Fashion Cabinet vendors yantra4d-hardware.snapshot.json. Per Yantra4D slug: the Fashion Cabinet objects that consume it and the solid parameters they drive. Contract: docs/spec/v1/hardware-ref.md. Do not hand-edit.

wanted.reason: Co-create target, now BUILT upstream (span/knots resolve against the pinned snapshot) — but changpao and jeogori-jacket still carry linked:false. Flipping them is a cartridge change, not an index change: each needs its params_map re-checked against the solid's sew_tail flange and the dimensional handshake satisfied. Tracked as the first re-point candidate.

No Yantra4D solid models a hammer loop's stiffening insert yet; the FC-400 index carries it as `yantra4d/hammer-loop (co-create)`. painters-pant keeps an honest placeholder until the solid is built upstream. This is the one claim in the repo that does not resolve against the upstream catalog at all.

The Yantra4D solid exists and is vendored, but hi-vis-vest's placeholder predates it and maps a parameter the solid does not have ('overlap_mm'; the solid exposes strip_length / strip_width / sew_margin). Honest linked:false until the placket math is re-expressed against the real parameter set — a false link would resolve by name and lie about the geometry.
